description: This file implements extended FLASH hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions for STM32F7xx microcontrollers, including flash memory erase, option bytes programming, and configuration management.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Performs mass erase or sector erase of flash memory, with polling for completion.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Performs mass erase or sector erase of flash memory, with interrupt-based completion.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs option bytes such as write protection, read protection level, BOR level, and boot addresses.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration of option bytes.
